segments: Five map facts that sound fake. Number five is the strangest.
One. Reno, Nevada is farther west than Los Angeles.
Two. The whole country of Monaco is smaller than Central Park in New York.
Three. Canada has sixty two percent of the world's big lakes. Almost nine hundred thousand of them.
Four. France has twelve time zones. More than any other country, even Russia.
Five. In Samoa, Friday, December thirtieth, twenty eleven, never happened. The whole country skipped it.
Which one did you not believe? Tell me in the comments.
